products.label: Products
products.heading: Three Core Implant Platforms
products.scsDesc: As the gold standard for long-term pain management, SCS delivers high-frequency electrical pulses to specific spinal targets through minimally invasive implantation, precisely blocking pain signal transmission. The device supports ultra-long wireless battery life with intelligent programming.
products.pnsDesc: Based on closed-loop biosensing and intelligent feedback mechanisms, designed for neurological conditions such as essential tremor and epilepsy, the device adaptively modulates pulse intensity to gently restore normal neural rhythms.
products.tnsDesc: Breaking the volume limitations of traditional neuromodulation, using ultra-miniature wireless electrode array design to precisely target peripheral nerve plexuses, minimally invasively improving local neurological dysfunction and restoring patients' freedom of movement.

hero.label: About Shenluo
hero.desc: Founded in 2018 and located in the AI Town of Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Shenluo Medical Technology is a high-tech enterprise focusing on neuromodulation product R&D and manufacturing. With nearly 2,000 square meters of Class 100,000 GMP facility and Class 10,000 biochemical laboratory, we are committed to creating internationally leading neuromodulation products. Our independently developed products encompass implantable spinal cord stimulators (SCS), peripheral nerve stimulators (PNS), ultra-small spinal cord stimulators (M-SCS), tibial nerve stimulation (TNS), and sleep apnea stimulators, bringing significant quality-of-life improvements to patients. As the only global enterprise simultaneously mastering three major neuromodulation technology platforms — rechargeable implantable pulse generator (IPG), short-term semi-implantable, and wireless energy transfer — Shenluo Medical continues to provide physicians and patients with more advanced and effective treatment options. To date, the company has completed Series C financing, raising hundreds of millions of yuan...

products.scsEngName: Implantable Rechargeable Spinal Cord Stimulation . SCS
products.scsDesc:
Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) is a well-established pain treatment method that has been used by physicians for over 50 years. As a minimally invasive, reversible advanced medical technology, it aims to relieve pain and improve patients' functional ability and quality of life. It is primarily used to treat chronic intractable pain of the trunk and limbs (such as post-lumbar surgery syndrome, complex regional pain syndrome, etc.).
Through minimally invasive electrode implantation into the spinal epidural space
products.pnsDesc: Peripheral Nerve Stimulation (PNS) is an innovative neuromodulation technology that precisely intervenes in abnormal nervous system activity by targeting peripheral nerves, offering new treatment options for patients with drug-refractory neurological disorders.
products.tnsDesc: Tibial Nerve Stimulation (TNS) is an advanced neuromodulation technology for treating bladder dysfunction. By stimulating the tibial nerve, it regulates bladder function, improving urinary control and pelvic floor function.
products.manualDesc: Learn about SCS, a spinal cord stimulation system that helps treat certain types of chronic intractable pain.

faq.a1: You can make an appointment through the following methods: 1. Log in to the hospital's official website for online booking; 2. Call the appointment hotline 400-888-8888; 3. Download the hospital official app for booking; 4. Visit the hospital registration window for on-site booking.
faq.q2: How to check in after making an appointment?
faq.a2: After a successful appointment, please bring the patient's valid ID (ID card, medical insurance card, etc.) to the hospital registration window or self-service kiosk on the day of the visit. It is recommended to arrive 30 minutes early.
faq.q3: What documents should I bring for the visit?
faq.a3: Please bring the patient's valid ID (ID card, household registration book, etc.), medical insurance card (if applicable), previous medical records, examination reports, test results, and other relevant medical documents.
faq.a4: You can check examination reports through the hospital's official website, app, or WeChat official account. Generally, examination reports are available within 1-3 working days after completion.
faq.q5: What payment methods does the hospital accept?
faq.a5: The hospital accepts multiple payment methods: cash, bank card, medical insurance card, WeChat Pay, Alipay, etc.
